application.title: Join the SkelApp Affiliate Program
application.intro: To sign up for the SkelApp affiliate program, please fill out the form below. We encourage you to provide as much information as possible so we can properly evaluate your application. We will review and get back to you within five business days.
application.email_helper: We will use this email address to contact you about your application and next steps.
application.phone_helper: Enter the best mobile number for application follow-up and onboarding updates.
application.promotion_intro: Provide relevant information about your business or marketing capabilities to help us evaluate your application.
application.marketing_details_label: Tell us about your audience or marketing capabilities
application.marketing_details_placeholder: Share the kind of audience you reach, where you promote products, and why SkelApp would be a good fit for your network.
application.agreement_label: I accept the SkelApp affiliate agreement, Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
application.marketing_label: I agree to receive emails and promotional communications.
application.eligibility_label: I confirm that the information I have provided is accurate and that I am applying as a legitimate affiliate partner.
application.success_message: Thanks, {first_name}. We've received your affiliate application and will review it within five business days.
